reviews.author: Yelena Verechshagina
reviews.text: An absolute lifesaver! Forget the RTA branch queues!I needed to renew my driving license, which had been expired for over 5 years since I didn’t really need it. Because of this, there was a fine accumulated, and as many of you know, you usually have to visit an RTA branch in person for such cases—the online option just isn't available.When I finally braced myself to get it done, I was dreading the whole process: stuck in traffic, hunting for parking near the RTA, dealing with long queues, and, of course, doing the mandatory eye test. I had written off at least half a day for this nightmare... Sounds familiar, right?Well, you can forget all about that if you come to this optical shop!I simply found the nearest optics on Google, called them up, and the price of AED 140 for the eye test sounded reasonable. My plan was to just do the test there and then drive to the RTA.However, when I arrived, I was welcomed by Asif—an incredibly kind and professional soul. Not only did he give me amazing professional advice regarding my vision, but he also offered to renew my driving license right there in the shop! To say I was shocked is an understatement, as I was absolutely sure this could only be processed at an official RTA branch.Asif filled out all the necessary forms on the portal, and within just 10 minutes, my driving license was renewed! It saved me an incredible amount of time, energy, nerves, and money.I am so grateful that there are people like Asif who don't just give advice but genuinely help you save your precious time and resources. A huge thank you to the management and to Asif personally for helping me with my license renewal.To anyone looking to renew their driving license: this is the ultimate life hack! Highly recommended
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review and for your support. We are delighted to hear that you received great service from Asif. We appreciate your support and look forward to serving you again in the future.

reviews.author: simple man
reviews.text:
I had an outstanding experience at Eye Life Optics in JLT! I visited them because I was facing a serious axis issue with my newly made specs. While most other opticians usually ask you to 'try the specs for a few days' to adjust, the team here was different.

A huge shoutout to Dr. Asif, who diagnosed my long-term axis problem immediately. instead of making me wait, they did an instant replacement and made the perfect lenses for me. His expertise is unmatched.

I also want to thank Mr. Mohammad, whose hospitality was excellent. He helped me choose an awesome premium Ferrari frame that looks great. They are very approachable and genuinely dedicated to solving your problems in the best way possible.

They handle everything here—optical insurance, non-insurance, and RTA eye tests. If you are in Dubai, this is a must-visit. I’m sure you won’t come away empty-handed!
